title: The Night-Owl Signal
description: 44% of all 94,194 track plays fall between 10 PM and 5 AM IST. Late-night listening is unusually frequent.

title: Weekday Spending, Weekend Living
description: 763 of 2461 household records fall on weekends — routine spending clusters on weekdays while event-type records appear near weekends.

title: A Small Circle of Sound
description: Just 5 artists — The Beatles, The Killers, John Mayer, Bob Dylan, Paul McCartney — account for 21% of all plays. The Beatles alone: 7,806 plays.

title: The Sound Moved On
description: Comparing 2015–16 (5,370 plays) with 2017–18 (21,473 plays): only 2 of the top-5 artists overlap. Early: The Beatles, Johnny Cash, Elvis Presley, Frank Sinatra, Led Zeppelin. Later: The Beatles, John Mayer, The Killers, Bob Dylan, Johnny Cash.

title: The First-of-Month Money Ritual
description: 53% of salary, investment and family-support records land in the first 7 days of the month — pay arrives, investments leave, money goes home.

title: Life in Motion
description: The same anonymized stops recur constantly — place-0 ×110, place-2 ×38, place-1 ×25, place-6 ×21. Commute corridors, not one-off trips.

title: Music Evenings, With Food Nearby
description: 63 music↔food/entertainment links appear in evening windows across 7 distinct dates — listening and eating keep showing up together after 5 PM.
